config.rhodium.tooltip.mode.automatic: Automatic mode adjusts quality based on FPS.
config.rhodium.tooltip.mode.manual: Manual mode stops automatic adjustments and uses your fixed values.
config.rhodium.tooltip.enabled: Turns Rhodium optimization on or off (K key).
config.rhodium.tooltip.drop_threshold: Quality is lowered when average frame time exceeds this share of the target frame budget.
config.rhodium.tooltip.rise_threshold: Quality is raised when average frame time falls below this share of the target frame budget.
config.rhodium.tooltip.upgrade_margin: Raise quality only when average FPS exceeds the target by this percentage.
config.rhodium.tooltip.max_render_distan: Highest render distance automatic quality increases may reach. Default: 16 chunks.
config.rhodium.tooltip.max_simulation_di: Highest simulation distance automatic quality increases may reach. Default: 12 chunks.
config.rhodium.tooltip.manage_particles: Allow automatic mode to change the particle level?
config.rhodium.tooltip.manage_entity_dis: Allow automatic mode to change entity render distance?
config.rhodium.tooltip.manage_simulation: Allow automatic mode to change simulation distance in single-player?
config.rhodium.tooltip.manage_render_dis: Allow automatic mode to change render (chunk) distance?
config.rhodium.tooltip.min_render_distan: The lowest fixed value for render distance.
config.rhodium.tooltip.min_simulation_di: The lowest fixed value for simulation distance.
config.rhodium.tooltip.min_start_percent: The lowest percentage of the starting value that settings can reach.
config.rhodium.tooltip.min_entity_distan: The lowest fixed value for entity render distance.
config.rhodium.tooltip.rise_stability: How long FPS must remain stable before quality increases.
config.rhodium.tooltip.max_drops: Maximum number of lowering steps per minute.
config.rhodium.tooltip.max_rises: Maximum number of raising steps per minute.
config.rhodium.tooltip.manual_render_dis: Render distance used while manual mode is active.
config.rhodium.tooltip.manual_simulation: Simulation distance used in single-player while manual mode is active.
config.rhodium.tooltip.manual_particles: Particle level used while manual mode is active.
config.rhodium.tooltip.manual_entity_dis: Entity render distance used while manual mode is active.
config.rhodium.tooltip.overlay_notificat: Show setting changes in the on-screen action bar.
config.rhodium.tooltip.chat_notification: Write setting changes to chat history.
config.rhodium.tooltip.reset: Restore all Rhodium settings to their defaults.
debug.rhodium.manual: Manual mode: automatic adjustment is off
